_comment: Override ONLY the baseUrl of the built-in openrouter provider — the built-in
model catalog is kept (pi docs/models.md, 'Overriding Built-in Providers'), so
All traffic goes to hallmark-gw — the only host reachable from the hm-int network.
The real OpenRouter key never enters the container: the gateway sets Authorization,
and pi runs with a dummy OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
openai/gpt-6-astra was released after pi 0.84.3 and is missing from its built-in
catalog. Its entry is copied from the built-in openai/gpt-5.6-sol (api, compat,
thinkingLevelMap); prices are OpenRouter's as of 2026-09-15. Custom models are
upserted by id, so built-in ones stay unchanged (checked by diffing --list-models).
openai/gpt-6.1-sol: entry modelled on Astra; prices are OpenRouter's as of 2026-10-16
